breakdown.description: The opposing horizontal tractions are reinterpreted as boundary-normal loads on the horizontal edges
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly reinterpreted a horizontal traction load (shear) as a normal traction load (compressive/tensile). The ground truth corrected this by removing the erroneous reinterpretation, leaving the original horizontal load (`σ_xx=±1000 Pa (top/bottom)`). The agent, however, followed the incorrect reinterpretation and explicitly defined the loads as normal tractions on the horizontal edges, stating they are 'directed in the negative y-direction' and 'positive y-direction'.
